vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — coverage denominator and arithmetic
note: All counts, identifiers and instants are abstract. No completeness result or aggregate percentage is claimed.

cases.rule: accepted + missing + rejected = denominator with disjoint parts and typed gaps.
No PASS without a declared denominator, universe, denominator identity, count basis, as-of instant and evidence reference.
An undeclared or overlapping decomposition fails; any different arithmetic must be declared with component meanings.
A producer-supplied PASS is admitted only when all required evidence is present and the independent evaluation agrees.
Each dimension as-of uses the ratified instant grammar and is consistent with the release as-of.
Gaps are typed records, not free strings, and are never silently filled or interpolated.

cases.condition: only eight distinct dimension_id values are present in coverage.dimensions
cases.rule: All nine separate dimensions are required; passing one implies nothing about another.
